fixture_scope: synthetic public P3/P4 fixture; not a real model-quality run

browser_regression.flow: open saved draft, jump to PDF evidence, edit, save, reload, reopen, download Markdown and PDF

environment.pandoc: pypandoc bundled 3.9 exposed on PATH for this check

limitations: This check uses a deterministic public fixture and fake model response; it proves product controls, not scientific quality.
The current website cannot create or inspect P2-A, P2-B, P2-C, or P3 professional runs.
The current website has no external-evidence verification form equivalent to the P4.1 API.
Actual rendered documents remain in ignored local evaluation storage.
